tolerance_rationale: Worst measured relative drift across all tolerance_numeric stages is 5.997790e-10 (per_seed_metrics / aggregate_metrics). rtol=1e-6 is the repo-wide floor and leaves roughly 1,700x of margin. It is NOT tightened below the floor: these stages have been measured on macOS only, and tightening an unmeasured cross-platform claim is the mistake v0.33e, v0.35a and v0.35c each made.

normalization_vector.justification: Column normalization of the weak-form design matrix was added in v0.34c. v0.22.0 has no counterpart, so there is nothing to compare against and a comparison would have to invent a legacy baseline.

qualitative_invariants_note: Empty by design. generated_field_statistics was reclassified to tolerance_numeric at the confirmatory freeze; no alpha stage is qualitative_invariant. See the freeze, amendment 3.
